title: Android Navigation
description: Type-safe Compose Navigation for Android/KMP using @Serializable route objects, one nav graph per feature, cross-feature callbacks to keep features decoupled, and assembly of feature nav graphs in :app. Covers route definitions, NavGraphBuilder extensions, and NavController patterns.
trigger_description: Use whenever setting up navigation, defining routes, adding a new screen to a nav graph, navigating between features, or wiring nav graphs in the app module. Trigger phrases: "set up navigation", "add a route", "navigate between screens", "nav graph", "NavController", "type-safe nav", "cross-feature navigation", "NavGraphBuilder".
author: Philipp Lackner
